programme.desc: Charmaine returns to 9MAG in hopes of getting her job back, Van takes his daughter on a college tour, and Don asks Ashley for another chance at a perfect wedding. A rumor started by an unlikely source gains legs quickly.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: The happiest day of Charmaine's life is overshadowed by a rumor that won't die. Ryan decides it's time for a change at 9MAG and Don is just the one to make it.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Walt talks to Jess and deals with the consequences of his actions. Donna takes her CBD business to new heights, while Tatti continues to fight to regain her manager position.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Bae is officially back at the Brooklyn shop. Ceaser decides to relocate the entire crew to Atlanta but Puma's nerves get the best of him when someone tests positive for COVID.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew moves into their new mansion in Atlanta. Tatti gets a promotion at the shop, while Donna starts a new hustle that puts them on a collision course. Meanwhile, a family crisis devastates Ceaser.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After a rocky start in Atlanta, things only get worse as Rok and Krystal's relationship gets tested by an artist in the Atlanta crew. Donna and Tatti's argument over a space in the new shop spills over into their personal lives.
programme.sub-title: Between a Rok and a Hard Place

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Tensions between Donna and the team come to a head when the Black Ink Bosses decide to bring the teams together for some team bonding in the woods.
programme.sub-title: The Story of the Spyder and the Fish

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Tired of the constant fighting over who the best tattoo artist is, Ceaser decides to have the Black Ink artists put their art where their mouth is by conducting the first Black Ink tattoo competition to crown the lead artist.
programme.sub-title: It's Better When a Woman is in Charge

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Alex struggles with quarantining and his relationship with Donna, Tatti heads to Long Island to check on her family, and Krystal performs at Ted's showcase.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: As the crew gets ready to return to New York, Ceaser plans a final party in Atlanta and stuns Suzette when he gets down on one knee. Walt goes to extreme lengths to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: In the season premiere, the crew celebrates 10 years of Black Ink. The first ever Black Ink graduation ceremony goes left when Ceaser realizes that not everyone deserves to be head of the class.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After Ceaser's talk with Ted and Puma, it's time for him to take on the other problem child. While Puma continues to handle things at home, Quani tries to find her independence and herself.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Spyder worries that his first pop-up shop will be a flop as Tatti looks to Krystal and Bae for advice on a special assignment. The Black Ink Bosses finally reunite after their heated confrontation.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser makes a public announcement about changes at the shop that could have a chilling effect on Rok and Krystal. Tatti gets a cold lesson in humility from Bae while deciding to take some personal matters into her own hands.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.desc: Travis is hired to apprehend Father Abode, a former student of Dr. Novak, who has been producing genetic mutants for the sexual pleasure of wealthy clients. The chase reveals dark information about Marcus's past.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Chasing Janus (REDUX)
programme.desc: During a 'sting' operation, Callie is critically wounded. The crew of the Tulip race against the clock to track down her powerful family, who may have the means to save her.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Spaceman (REDUX)
programme.desc: While exploring a debris field, the Trans-Utopian discovers a sarcophagus floating in space. Mishkin, the lone occupant, spreads an experimental mind-warping disease among the crew that empowers their alter-egos and cause dangerous conflicts.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Becoming Shiva (REDUX)
programme.desc: A Terran terrorist group protesting the ecological disasters that have plagued them detonate a bomb on the city state space station, Ring Sheppard. The crew are hired to track them down and break the ring up. More easily said than done.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: The Third Thing (REDUX)
programme.desc: The the in-brain reality TV series "The Third Thing", follow the crew of the Trans-Utopian. Marcus, is given the job of capturing a petty criminal for the show. As the "simple" mission unfolds, it becomes much deadlier than it seemed.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Torment (REDUX)
programme.desc: Percy, Travis, and crew try to rescue a man's parents caught in a cruel time-dilation trap; kidnapped years earlier into a high-speed orbit, they only age 8 months relative to their son's 50 years.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Painless (REDUX)
programme.desc: Roan, a friend of the Montana family, is killed by Anestha, a new street drug. As Travis hunts for Bliss, a narcotics ringleader, he stumbles upon a deep scam that could only happen in the 23rd century.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Skin Deep (REDUX)
programme.desc: Callie's reunion with old friend Lena goes awry when a rival starhunter attempts to arrest Lena for murder. Percy and Marcus leave the ship to buy an anti-matter stabilizer, but the deal goes poorly and the two find themselves stranded in Io's Syn City.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Supermax Redux (REDUX)
programme.desc: While transporting Quigley, a prisoner who appears to be quite insane, the crew save the lives of an old nemesis and his associates. Max offers to share a stash of Onmium, a mineral rarer than diamonds and worth billions.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Pandora's Box (REDUX)
programme.desc: The Trans-Utopian experiences a power drain caused by Keres Station research facility. Not knowing they are the cause, Travis accepts an assignment from their head scientist to capture the Raider Quennell and retrieve a sample of the deadly Tethys Virus.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Room 2426
programme.desc: Martin Decker is confined to a special room for acts and thoughts against the state. They want the formula for a weapon he does not want to reveal. Escape for Martin comes from the mind.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Mind of Simon Foster
programme.desc: In an impoverished future, Simon Foster goes to a pawnshop to sell some personal items to raise money for rent. The shop owner offers to buy some of his memories. In Simon Foster's life, what could be possibly be valuable?

programme.desc: A U.S. military experiment opens a portal to an unknown place. After sending through one team, the Army calls upon a career soldier to investigate, where he finds an idyllic planet. He has to decide whether to stay or go back to his old life.

programme.title: South Park: Major B**bage
programme.desc: Major B**bage: The hysterical parents of South Park have another reason to panic after 'cheesing' becomes popular among kids. Kenny becomes addicted to the out-of-this-world hallucinations. (S12, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Canada on Strike
programme.desc: Canada on Strike: Canada is brought to the brink of collapse after a drawn out strike in pursuit of 'some of that internet money'. Can the boys save the day with a "YouToob" sensation? (S12, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Eek, A Pen*s!
programme.desc: Eek, A Pen*s! Ms. Garrison wants to become a man again, so whilst she is away Cartman becomes the sub teacher. It's not long before Cartman is teaching innercity kids the fun of cheating! (S12, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Over Logging
programme.desc: Over Logging: Panic reigns as South Park finds that the internet's gone! The Marshes decide to go hunting for the internet in California and end up in an "internet refugee camp". (S12, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Super Fun Time
programme.desc: Super Fun Time: The kids go on a field trip to a 'living museum'. A hostage situation ensues when robbers use the place to evade police. It's up to Cartman and Butters to save the day! (S12, E07)

programme.title: South Park: The China Probrem
programme.desc: The China Probrem: Alarmed by the grandeur of the Olympic ceremonies, Cartman enlists Butters to help him confront the Chinese. (S12, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Breast Cancer Show Ever
programme.desc: Breast Cancer Show Ever: Cartman's reputation is at stake when he is too afraid to fight Wendy, who is furious about his breast cancer jibes. Cartman then takes things from bad to worse! (S12, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic (Part 1)
programme.desc: Pandemic (1): South Park goes all 'Cloverfield' when large, mysterious creatures begin causing havoc around the globe, all caught on Randy's shaky cam. The boys start a Peruvian flute band. (S12, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic 2: The Startling (Part 2)
programme.desc: Pandemic 2 - The Startling (2): Giant guinea pigs are attacking cities around the world. The boys have the key which will save humanity, but they are stuck in the Andes and bored to boot! (S12, E11)

programme.title: South Park: About Last Night...
programme.desc: About Last Night...: While the country celebrates the election of Obama, a band of unlikely super-thieves begin an audacious jewel heist. The town's Republicans fear the apocalypse is nigh. (S12, E12)

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Uprising
programme.desc: A riot breaks out at a women’s correctional institute while Andy, Juliet, Nick, and Gail are there to transfer prisoners. They end up in a lock-down situation that finds Andy and Juliet trapped with a woman desperate to prove her innocence

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Letting Go
programme.desc: When Nick’s estranged older brother emerges with new information on someone from their tragic past, Nick goes off the grid to track the man down. But Juliet is hot on his heels, and Nick is forced to let her into the secrets of his past.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: A Real Gentleman
programme.desc: When Traci is a no-show for her first raid, 15 Division fears the notorious gun dealer they’re after has kidnapped her. But when Andy realizes that the serial rapist we never caught is back, it’s all hands on deck to find Traci

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Home Run
programme.desc: After a community-outreach baseball game erupts in a drive-by shooting, Gail’s relationship with her brother is put to the test . Meanwhile, Swarek plans a getaway with Andy up to Oliver’s cabin, which goes off the rails in every possible way

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Best Man
programme.desc: Andy and Sam are shocked to learn that Oliver is the prime suspect in IA’s corruption investigation into 15 Division. They only have until end of day today to find Chris Klem – the missing explosives-dealer – and clear Oliver’s name

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 008
programme.desc: When 2Dads agrees to help try to fix a privately owned submarine at sea, it leads to a catastrophic accident.

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 009
programme.desc: Hammersley is in foreign waters assisting Madelaine Cruise on another clandestine ASIO mission. In a daring and dangerous evacuation on foreign soil, the RHIB party seek to rescue ASIO Agent Smith under gunfire.

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 010
programme.desc: A team building exercise for the junior Hammersley sailors turns into a deadly nightmare, meanwhile long kept secrets are reaching crisis point on board.

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 011
programme.desc: After a wild night on the town in the port of Samjung, one member of the Hammersley crew wakes to find he has a crushing hangover, a beautiful woman by his side - and a wedding ring on his finger.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: When the CSIs process clues after a murder at a poultry manufacturing plant, the evidence leads them to the home of a man who collects miniature trains and other miniature paraphernalia.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: Catherine's testimony in court is not enough to convict a killer suspected of murdering his own mother. Adam Novak, with whom Catherine had a brief romantic encounter, is the lawyer who represents the killer and secures his freedom.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: The lead suspect for the high-profile murder of anti-drug crusading assemblyman Danilo Zamesca is Thomas Simon, the west coast's biggest drug supplier.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Integrity Test
programme.desc: With Oliver still the prime suspect in the bombing of 15’s evidence room, Andy, Dov, Gail, and Nick undertake a risky – and potentially career-ending – plan to prove that Commissioner Alonso Santana is corrupt.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Ninety Degrees
programme.desc: Andy heads out with a very-pregnant Marlo to find a volatile woman who’s gone missing after group therapy, but neither Andy nor Marlo are prepared when Marlo suddenly goes into labor.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Breaking Up the Band
programme.desc: Now that Sam and Marlo’s baby girl has arrived (Ep. 520), it’s clear nothing could have prepared Andy for this moment. So when Juliet offers Andy an opportunity to leave town for 4 months on an undercover project, Andy starts to consider it.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Elijah Kane is prepping his team for court in Nicoli Putin's murder trial when they’re ambushed by Nicoli’s highly trained menout to stop Kane’s team from testifying.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Following the attack on his precinct, Kane buries his friends and sets his sights on avenging their deaths. He assembles a new team and follows the trail across the border to Vancouver.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Now in Vancouver, Kane joins forces with the CIA to take down a lawyer who had a hand in the attack on Kane’s precinct. The CIA wants the lawyer dead, and promises it will bring Kane one step closer to the man responsible for it all: The Ghost.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: The CIA asks Kane and his team to take down a high-level gang boss involved in human smuggling, but Kane’s investigation uncovers a larger conspiracy involving organ-trafficking.

programme.title: COPS

programme.title: COPS

programme.title: COPS

programme.desc: A spell to get her just desserts leaves Sabrina with egg on her face instead.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Christmas Amnesia
programme.desc: It’s beginning to look a lot like Christmas until Sabrina accidentally erases the holiday

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina and The Beast
programme.desc: In order to teach Sabrina a lesson about love and beauty, Harvey is turned into a beast.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Whose So-Called Life is it Anyway?
programme.desc: Sabrina’s charitable magic turns out to be anything but a good deed.
programme.sub-title: Whose So-Called Life is it Anyway?

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina The Matchmaker
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Sabrina must help two people fall in love or suffer Cupid’s wrath.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: What Price Harvey?
programme.desc: Magical ambition shows its dark side when Harvey drops out of school to become an industrial tycoon.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina And The Pirates
programme.desc: Purchasing a fake ID in the Other Realm causes Sabrina’s magic to become fake as well.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Mrs. Kraft
programme.desc: Mr. Kraft’s ex-wife returns to win him back, but Zelda isn’t going to let him go without a fight.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina The Teenage Writer
programme.desc: When typed on a magical typewriter, Sabrina’s spy story and its characters come to life.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Salem The Boy
programme.desc: Salem's return to human form is short-lived, thanks to Roland the Troll and Sabrina's unknowing wishes.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: The Long and Winding Short Cut
programme.desc: Sabrina is stripped of modern conveniences after using shortcuts to solve her family secret.
programme.sub-title: The Long and Winding Short Cut

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina The Sandman
programme.desc: Employed as a Sandman, Sabrina gets into trouble dropping into other people’s dreams.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Pen Pal
programme.desc: Sabrina discovers her new pen pal witch is wanted in two realms.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: The Good The Bad And The Luau (Season Finale)
programme.desc: Sabrina and her aunts travel to Hawaii for a family reunion, but when they arrive, Sabrina discovers that she will not be able to enjoy herself until she solves the family secret once and for all.
programme.sub-title: The Good The Bad And The Luau (Season Finale)

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Silent Movie

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Dream A Little Dreama Me
programme.desc: Her Witches License and a new student bring Sabrina a new set of challenges.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: No Place Like Home (Season Premiere)
programme.desc: Sabrina’s senior year of high school gets off to a rocky start.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Salem And Juliette
programme.desc: Sabrina helps Salem find a date for his high school reunion.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Jealousy

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Prelude To A Kiss

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: The Phantom Menace
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, and Sabrina is having a ghoulish time adjusting to her new job at the coffee house.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Little Orphan Hilda
programme.desc: Hilda and Zelda experience a life-changing event when they discover they are adopted.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Spoiled Rotten

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Aging Not So Gracefully

programme.title: Arriba Las Manos Texano
programme.desc: El texano, hijo de Manuel Saldivar, un asesino cruel y desalmado, emprende un viaje para llegar al rancho de Joe Pastrana. Al llegar se entera por su hija, que Joe a muerto victima de una balacera comandada por Jim, un cruel hombre.

programme.title: Una horca para el texano
programme.desc: Frank, Peter, Robert y Leop Morgan son buscados por todo un pueblo,ya que roban bancos y matan. Pronto un comisario llega para resolver el asesinato del presidente del banco y poner tras las rejas a estos cuatro bandidos.

programme.title: Vuelve El Texano
programme.desc: El texano, es un hombre muy famoso del pueblo de Santa Fe, el decide regresar a su pueblo natal, a su llegada se entera de que alguien ha estado matando a varias personas e incluso a extorsionarlas por lo que decide descubrir y eliminar al susodicho.

programme.title: Un Tipo A Todo Dar
programme.desc: Javier es un provinciano que llega a trabajar a la Ciudad de México, a su llegada se aloja en una pobre vecindad donde conoce a Rosa, quien le consigue trabajo con su padre dentro de una carnicería

programme.title: Cuando Habla El Corazon
programme.desc: Historia que demuestra la amistad entre dos amigos, que a lo largo de los años se demuestran que hay que ser valientes y leales. Tratando de defender a su amada, pero también a la fiel a la amistad que se deben.

programme.title: La Norteña De Mis Amores
programme.desc: Carlos Macias, ya convertido en un hombre hecho y derecho decide regresar el dia de su cumpleaños numero 21 a su pueblo natal, esto con el fin de cobrar venganza en contra de Jacinto Escobedo, un hombre aficionado a las opuestas.

programme.title: La Sonrisa De Los Pobres
programme.desc: Julio, llega a la capital luego de estudiar mecánica automotriz. Una empresa lo contrata pero como oficinista, por lo que quiere renunciar pero resiste para estar cerca de la secretaria Lupe. Se casa con Lupe y ella se sale de trabajar.

programme.title: Las Tapatias Nunca Pierden
programme.desc: Griselda Grijalba, cuyo sueño es ser cantante a toda costa aunque esto la lleve a desobedecer a su abuelo Don Fulgencio, recibe como herencia por parte de su difunto abuelo Eduardo Rios una finca muy grande en pueblo viejo, el rancho del olvido.

programme.title: Los Barbaros Del Norte
programme.desc: Olivia Fullet, va en busca de su hermano Antonio quien según esta a punto de llegar en su barco a la playa proveniente de Panama junto con su amigo Pierre. Antes de llegar, su pequeño barco se estrella en las rocas, quedando un solo sobreviviente.

programme.title: Un Monje a Pruebas de Balas
programme.desc: Un monje tibetano inmortal se convierte en el mentor de un joven chico a quien enseña a proteger un viejo pergamino que el monje ha cuidado durante sesenta años. Con la ayuda de una escurridiza joven, ambos combatirán contra un malvado maestro de kung fu.

programme.title: Tres Ladrones y un Bebé
programme.desc: Fong es un ladrón con mala suerte. Con unas habilidades excepcionales, Fong siempre pierde todas sus ganancias en sus robos de apuestas. Su gran oportunidad llega cuando un gángster les pide a él y a su compañero pulpo que secuestren a un importante bebé.

programme.title: Bruce Lee - My Brother
programme.desc: Bruce Lee, My Brother es una dramática película biográfica de la leyenda homónima de las artes marciales contada por su hermano menor, Robert Lee.

programme.title: THE EXPENDABLES
programme.desc: En 'The Expendables' el trío de héroes de acción compuesto por Stallone, Statham y Li formarán parte de un comando de mercenarios que se infiltrarán en un país de Sudamérica y lucharán contra un un cruel dictador para liberar a la población.

programme.title: Police Story - A Guerra das Drogas
programme.desc: Ka Kui (Jackie Chan) arresta a un jefe criminal, pero su secretaria lo traiciona para liberarlo. Además, trata con su novia celosa.

programme.title: Vehículo 19
programme.desc: Un hombre en libertad condicional elige el vehículo de renta equivocado y descubre que es el objetivo de una fuerza policíaca. Los policías harán cualquier cosa por evitar el testimonio de corrupción de una mujer que está en el maletero del coche

programme.title: Plan de Escape: El Rescate
programme.desc: Después de que el experto en seguridad Ray Breslin es contratado para rescatar a la hija secuestrada de un magnate de Hong Kong, la novia de Breslin también es capturada.

programme.title: Institnto predador
programme.desc: Frank captura animales salvajes en la jungla brasileña, incluido un jaguar blanco de 180 kilos. Los embarca en el mismo barco que un asesino arrestado. El asesino se libera y libera a los animales.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: War of the Worlds 2: The Next Wave
programme.desc: Dos años después de la invasión marciana, se dan cuenta de los peores temores de George Herbert: han regresado.

programme.title: Andreas Quake
programme.desc: Cuando una desacreditada sismóloga advierte de un inminente terremoto de 12.7, nadie la toma en serio. Ahora, corre desesperadamente para poner a salvo a su familia antes de que el terremoto rompa Los Ángeles.

programme.title: Shin-Ultraman
programme.desc: Mientras la amenaza de las formas de vida gigantes no identificadas conocidas como "Especies de Clase S" se agrava en Japón, un gigante plateado aparece desde más allá de la atmósfera terrestre.

programme.title: Amenaza en el Espacio
programme.desc: En la cúspide de la paternidad, un mecánico junior a bordo de un arca interestelar a la Nueva Tierra debe burlar un terror cósmico malévolo intención de utilizar la nave espacial como un arma.

programme.title: Yo, Frankenstein
programme.desc: La criatura de Frankenstein se encuentra atrapada en una guerra total de siglos de antigüedad entre dos clanes inmortales.

programme.title: Battle of Los Angeles
programme.desc: En febrero de 1942, las fuerzas estadounidenses atacaron un objeto volador no identificado sobre Los Ángeles. Ahora, casi 70 años después, los invasores extraterrestres han regresado.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: En todo el mundo desciende una tormenta sin precedentes de categoría 6. Vientos violentos, presión a nivel de huracán y "callejones de tornados" sin precedentes se desarrollan en dos continentes.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: El efecto de calentamiento está creando nuevas regiones de clima extremo, pero algo más lo está desencadenando; algo que cuando se combina con olas de calor récord crea explosiones en el cielo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Tracey Berrios experimenta una actividad paranormal dentro de su nuevo hogar, sospecha que hay espíritus vinculados a la historia de la casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, madre soltera de tres hijos, traslada a su familia para comenzar de nuevo, pero su sueño se convierte en una pesadilla cuando su familia se enfrenta a múltiples entidades.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Deborah Utley comienza a experimentar eventos paranormales en su hogar, recurre a su fe en busca de protección.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La sesión de espiritismo de Sam Baltrusis lo deja poseído y desesperado por estar a salvo. Un chamán lucha contra el espíritu, para que Sam pueda recuperar el control de su vida.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando una pareja trae un gabinete antiguo a su casa de Tennessee, comienzan a suceder eventos inexplicables. Buscando una respuesta, instalaron una cámara de vigilancia y capturaron pruebas de que el gabinete es la fuente de la actividad paranormal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una mujer hace el desgarrador descubrimiento de que su nuevo hogar alberga un portal paranormal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un investigador paranormal no cree en objetos embrujados hasta que captura la prueba de que posee una muñeca antigua que adquirió recientemente. Temiendo que esté perdido, intenta deshacerse de él, pero el malvado juguete tiene otros planes.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los recién casados ​​se encuentran en el blanco de un espíritu agresivo después de llevarse a casa los recuerdos de su luna de miel. La pareja teme que uno de los objetos esté embrujado y se acerca a los investigadores paranormales en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Devastada por el asesinato sin sentido de un amigo, una adolescente tiene una sesión espiritista para comunicarse por última vez e involuntariamente invita a una entidad malévola a su propia casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la ciudad de Springfield, estado de Illinois, el Lake Club es un monumento a una época pasada: un salón de baile donde multitud de personas alguna vez prosperaron, acompañados de los sonidos del jazz clásico.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Sandra e Isidro Nuno experimentan entidades oscuras que tienen como objetivo a sus dos hijas, Sabrina y Shanon, en su casa de Chicago. Desesperados por ayuda, los Nunos recurren a un "guerrero espiritual" para combatir a los demonios.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El sueño de Dana Walters de abrir una tienda de disfraces se ve interrumpido cuando descubren que el edificio que acaba de comprar está embrujado. Cuando el fantasma se vuelve más peligroso, ella llama a un espiritista psíquico local para que investigue.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El ex oficial de policía Joe Mignano se casa con su novia de la infancia, Danika, y los dos se enfrentan a una peligrosa actividad poltergeist en su casa en Rhode Island. Se ponen en contacto con un conocido demonólogo en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un fanático de las casas embrujadas y su sobrina compran un antiguo hospital en Tooele, Utah. A medida que lo transforman en una “casa encantada”, experimentan una serie de eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cathy Heglund vive una pesadilla cuando se ve obligada a regresar al hogar que atormentó su infancia. Cuando los espíritus se vuelven agresivos, los investigadores paranormales se unen para darle lo que ella ha deseado durante décadas... respuestas.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja se ve atacada por fuerzas espirituales convocadas por un ex celoso. A medida que las fuerzas se vuelven más violentas, recurren a múltiples expertos en su intento de romper la maldición por cualquier medio antes de que los disuelva.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Mary Jo Chudley queda encantada con un par de muñecas coleccionables y las lleva a casa. Los llama "Gretchen" y "Lily Mae" y pronto sufre una enfermedad relacionada con la sangre que casi la mata. ¿Son las muñecas responsables?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja remodela una antigua granja, despertando un espíritu que se burla de ellos y de su pequeña hija, en un intento de resolver deudas centenarias. Después de un encuentro casi fatal, una médium y dos investigadores se unen para poner fin al acoso.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando una joven pareja comienza a experimentar eventos inexplicables, descubren que el residente anterior nunca se fue. Los investigadores paranormales se dan cuenta de que el edificio necesita una liberación antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El sueño de Kim y Eric Masson de tener un restaurante se ve interrumpido cuando se dan cuenta de que el edificio está embrujado. Cuando la inquietud se vuelve terrible, los Masson acuden a la ayuda de investigadores paranormales.

programme.title: Dos Criados Malcriados
programme.desc: Capulina y Viruta entran a trabajar como sirvientes en la lujosa mansión de un millonario. Son torpes y casi arruínan la casa, pero al fin todos encuentran felicidad y amor con dos guapas sirvientas.

programme.title: Dos Locos en Escena
programme.desc: Durante el ensayo de una obra de teatro un actor pierde el conocimiento. Su compañero lo cree muerto y esconde el cuerpo en una caja. Capulina es el encargado de hacer la mudanza de las cajas y un juego de escondite se establece entre el y el “asesino.”

programme.title: Dos meseros majaderos
programme.desc: Capulina busca la ayuda de Viruta para trabajar en un centro nocturno donde él trabaja. Una peligrosa confusión hará que se vean envueltos en una investigación policíaca y en la mira de un peligroso asesino.

programme.title: El Carita
programme.desc: Capulina es un solitario que no puede encontrar novia. Un día, por un hechizo amanece como todo un galán. Todas las chicas lo buscan pero el solo quiere lograr el amor de una, a la que por mucho tiempo ha amado en secreto.

programme.title: El Dolor de Pagar la Renta
programme.desc: El dueño de una vecindad quiere lanzar a los inquilinos para construir otro dificio en el terreno. Capulina encuentra la manera de salvar a sus vecinos de perder sus hogares.

programme.title: El Guia de las Turistas
programme.desc: Un grupo de hermosas turistas es defraudado por la compañía de turismo que las deja a la deriva y sin dinero. Capulina al saber del problema decide ponerse al frente de la gira como guía de turistas y tiene un éxito fabuloso.

programme.title: El Hermano Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina abandona el digno oficio de limosnero, pero no por ello va a cometer la locura de trabajar. Va a dar a una orden de Frailes que se dedican a hacer la caridad y se enfrenta a los problemas de los Frailes y los de todos a su alrededor.

programme.title: El Investigador Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina confunde al vicepresidente de una empresa con un ladrón. Sus amigos los luchadores Tinieblas y Superzan acuden en su ayuda y evitan un asalto. Capulina creyéndose el héroe decide poner una agencia de investigadores.

programme.title: El Karateca Azteca
programme.desc: Capulina ayuda a un arqueólogo alemán y a su guapa hija, Nadia a visitar ruinas arqueológicas. Una banda de contrabandistas de piezas arqueológicas atrapa al padre de Nadia. Capulina combate a los malhechores con sus artes marciales.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En la boda real canadiense la princesa es secuestrada. Obsesionado por el casamiento real, Ike intenta resolver la situación, aunque para eso tenga que abandonar la obra de teatro de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison le explica a la clase la Teoría de la Evolución, aunque está totalmente en contra de esa postura. Mientras tanto, Cartman no puede esperar a que llegue el día del lanzamiento de una consola de videojuegos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al ver a un chico con el síndrome de Tourette en una juguetería, Cartman se obsesiona con el tema y se percata de que puede decir lo que quiera sin consecuencias, por lo que se aprovecha de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es invadido por hippies y Cartman trata de eliminarlos, tratándolos como si fueran una plaga. Mientras tanto, los hippies les están "lavando el cerebro" a Kyle, Stan y Kenny. Cartman es ahora la única esperanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: Siempre Alice
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Julianne Moore), 2014. La doctora Alice Howland es una profesora casada y madre de 3 hijos, no da importancia a los pequeños lapsus hasta que debe comenzar a luchar para seguir siendo Alice.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Francisco de Paula. Un grupo de adolescentes castigados en el instituto descubre la amistad y el amor mientras comparten sus problemas. En elenco podemos ver a Ivana Baquero, Patrick Criado, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón o Raúl Arévalo.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal protagoniza este thriller de acción sobre un hombre que despierta en el cuerpo de otro hombre para descubrir que solo él tiene la capacidad de detener un ataque terrorista en un tren de cercanías.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: La huella del silencio
programme.desc: Una niña de once años de una familia disfuncional demuestra un talento único, casi místico para deletrear. Cuando gana el concurso distrital y se califica al nacional, se vuelve el centro de la atención y gana la aprobación de su intelectual padre.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: La huella del silencio
programme.desc: Una niña de once años de una familia disfuncional demuestra un talento único, casi místico para deletrear. Cuando gana el concurso distrital y se califica al nacional, se vuelve el centro de la atención y gana la aprobación de su intelectual padre.

programme.title: Teniente Corrupto
programme.desc: El teniente Terence McDonough, adicto a las drogas por sus dolores crónicos de espalda, investiga el asesinato de cinco inmigrantes senegaleses en Nueva Orleans.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: El ladrón de Shanghai
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de un maestro en artes marciales, un intrépido joven se hace pasar por un príncipe llegado de un lejano país para poder casarse con la hija del Rey y aspirar al trono.

programme.title: Vuelo 192
programme.desc: Sarah Plummer, agente del FBI, ve cómo su familia es secuestrada durante un vuelo a Washington. Cuando una misteriosa pasajera se sienta a su lado, deberá tomar una decisión que puede costarle la vida de su marido y su hijo.

programme.title: Rescate en Damasco
programme.desc: Adib Abdel Kareem escapó de Siria hace más de 30 años, dejando atrás al amor de su vida, Fátima, para establecerse en Toronto y empezar una nueva vida. Pero ahora debe regresar a su país cuando su hija Muna, que es periodista, desaparece en Damasco.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda liderada por Macao Park planea un gran golpe en un casino. Pero sin honor entre ladrones, cada uno trama su propio plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: Mentiras e ilusiones
programme.desc: Un novelista de éxito en el género policiaco y de espionaje es perseguido por un espía que, basándose en sus novelas, cree que tiene escondidos millones de dólares en diamantes, robados por su difunta prometida.

programme.title: Amor a quemarropa
programme.desc: En Detroit, un friki de la cultura pop se casa con una puta, le roba cocaína a su chulo, e intenta venderla en Hollywood. Los propietarios de la coca les siguen la pista para recuperarla.

programme.title: Tiempo de héroes
programme.desc: Con el destino de la Segunda Guerra Mundial a punto de ceder a favor de los alemanes, el mayor Jones lidera la formación de un nuevo comando de asalto del ejército británico. Su primera misión secreta será la de introducirse en la Noruega ocupada.

programme.title: Un tipo de altura
programme.desc: El "largo" Dexter King, tímido y torpe, es el hombro de un comediante que trabaja en Drury Lane. Alérgico a las plumas, Dexter, a quien un médico le ha recetado una serie de inyecciones, conoce a la enfermera Kate y se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Solteras Indisponibles
programme.desc: Tres niñas pequeñas, mejores amigas, conocen a un hechicero que les concede un deseo: tener la misma suerte en el amor. Varios años después, cada una de ellas tiene su propia vida hasta que un día un evento inesperado cambia sus destinos

programme.title: El precio de la fama
programme.desc: Años 70 en Vevey, a orillas del lago Ginebra. Al salir de la cárcel, Eddy Ricaart va a casa de su amigo Osman Bricha. Han acordado que Eddy cuidará de Samira, la hija de Osman, mientras su esposa Noor está ingresada.

programme.title: El balneario de Battle Creek
programme.desc: El excéntrico doctor John Harvey Kellog es un defensor acérrimo de la vida natural y también regenta un lujoso balneario en Battle Creek, donde reúne a numerosos personajes de clase alta para poner en práctica sus peculiares normas dieteticas.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa

programme.title: Zenith – Avances en La Exploración Espacial: El sol
programme.desc: El Sol es nuestra estrella. Su energía permite que la vida en la Tierra prospere, pero sabemos muy poco sobre el clima solar y el ciclo solar de 11 años.

programme.title: Zenith – Avances en La Exploración Espacial: Telescopio Espacial
programme.desc: Los telescopios espaciales que orbitan por encima de los efectos distorsionadores de la atmósfera terrestre, como el Hubble, han hecho contribuciones increíbles a nuestro conocimiento del universo.

programme.title: Zenith – Avances en La Exploración Espacial: Más allá del sistema solar
programme.desc: Hay tantas preguntas sin respuesta sobre las estrellas, las galaxias y el universo, que simplemente mapear lo que hay en el cielo nocturno es inmensamente difícil.

programme.title: Zenith – Avances en La Exploración Espacial: Comunicación espacial
programme.desc: A medida que aumenta nuestra experiencia en tecnología espacial, se han producido efectos secundarios en muchas áreas: particularmente en las comunicaciones.

programme.title: Zenith – Avances en La Exploración Espacial: Tierra
programme.desc: El planeta más importante del sistema solar es nuestro hogar, la Tierra. Es el único planeta que conocemos que alberga vida.

programme.title: Zenith – Avances en La Exploración Espacial: El planeta azul: el futuro
programme.desc: Las tecnologías espaciales siguen perfeccionándose y el acceso al espacio es cada vez más barato.

programme.title: Los Testigos: Encuentros con Antiguos Alienígenas
programme.desc: El contactado, el vidente y el abducido comparten experiencias similares y diferentes con seres de otras dimensiones, dejando una marca duradera de su presencia.

programme.title: El Accidente OVNI en Roswell
programme.desc: Encubrimientos y conspiraciones... ¿Qué sucedió realmente esa noche en Roswell, en 1947?

programme.title: Alienígenas: Los Encuentros Esotéricos
programme.desc: Las historias teosóficas de Madame Blavatsky, los relatos sobre demonios Jinn, y la vida de Maria Orsic narran dimensiones en las cuales, a través de la espiritualidad y el esoterismo, es posible establecer contacto con alienígenas

programme.title: Archivos Gubernamentales de OVNIs Desclasificados
programme.desc: Los gobiernos guardan secretos. ¿Pero qué ocurre cuando estos secretos ya no pueden ser encubiertos más?

programme.title: Linda Napolitano: La Abducción Alienígena del Siglo
programme.desc: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

programme.title: El Incidente del Lago Falcon
programme.desc: Los extraterrestres visitan la Tierra a menudo; Destaca el incidente OVNI de 1967 en el lago Falcón de Canadá. Los frecuentes avistamientos de Canadá lo hacen enigmático.

programme.title: Cíclope Extraterrestre: El Extraordinario Caso de la Sagrada Familia
programme.desc: En 1963 en Brasil, tres niños son testigos de un OVNI en su patio trasero. Un cíclope alienígena desciende y el Sr. Alberto investiga el fenómeno.

programme.title: Cazadores De Ovnis II: Cuentos del Universo
programme.desc: Los ufólogos italianos exploran la evidencia alienígena en la historia y el folclore. ¿Hemos sido observados desde la antigüedad?

programme.title: Encubrimientos y Conspiraciones: El Globo Espía Chino
programme.desc: Objetos derribados en el espacio aéreo de Estados Unidos y Canadá. El Pentágono finge ignorancia. ¿Participación alienígena?

programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.desc: In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Scientist Karen Ross (Laura Linney) is sent by her father-in-law, mogul R.B. Travis (Joe Don Baker), to the Congo to determine the whereabouts of his son's missing diamond-hunting team. Led by expert guide Kelly (Ernie Hudson), Ross and a mismatched search party -- including primatologist Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), treasure hunter Herkermer Homolka (Tim Curry) and a gorilla -- discover a danger far more sinister than anything they expected to find, even in the heart of the jungle.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up.

programme.title: S.I.S.
programme.desc: A covert branch of the LAPD tracks known offenders and attempts to catch them in the act of committing crimes.

programme.title: Jury Duty
programme.desc: Justice isn't merely blind. Now, it's stupid, lazy and irresponsible, too.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: A federal agent is assigned to spy on his mother and her new lover, both suspects in an art theft ring.

programme.title: The Baby-Sitters Club
programme.desc: Seven young women on the cusp of their teenage years are challenged by adventures, family crises, and romance.

programme.title: The Notorious Landlady
programme.desc: When her husband disappears, Carlyle Hardwicke finds it impossible to rent a room in her London apartment, since everyone assumes she's a murderer. Recently arrived American diplomat William Gridley, however, has no idea about her reputation. Sparks fly between the pair, and Gridley rents the room. When his boss, Franklyn Ambruster, learns what Gridley has blundered into, he reproves him until he meets the lovely Carlyle. The two men try to clear her name.

programme.title: A Woman of Distinction
programme.desc: Reserved college dean Susan Middlecott (Rosalind Russell) is all business and can't be bothered with love. However, when Susan meets charming British astronomy professor Alec Stevenson (Ray Milland), it seems that romance could be in the air. Though she resists being paired with Alec, things don't go as planned -- particularly when a publicity agent and even Susan's amiable father (Edmund Gwenn) get involved. Soon Susan may just be in love, whether she likes it or not.

programme.title: The Silencers
programme.desc: Veteran secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) is living a life of luxury when his former lover, Tina Batori (Daliah Lavi), pulls him back into action. A sinister group known as the Big O has developed a plot to start a global nuclear conflict, so the carefree, womanizing Helm must stop the scheme of mastermind Tung-Tze (Victor Buono). Joining the suave Helm on his mission is the beautiful but inept operative Gail Hendricks (Stella Stevens), along with other gorgeous ladies.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: Leap of Faith
programme.desc: Steve Martin plays Reverend Jonas Nightengale, a slick-asoil flimflam man who'll trade salvation for a donation to his touring ministry. Jonas knows how to work a crowd and a con, but his works of wonder are done with mirrors and smoke.

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: Joanna Mills (Sarah Michelle Gellar) has a successful career but feels her personal life is spinning out of control. She has few friends, an estranged father (Sam Shepard), and a crazy ex-boyfriend who is stalking her. Joanna begins having terrifying visions of a woman's murder, and it seems that she is the killer's next target. Determined to solve the mystery and escape her apparent fate, Joanna follows her visions to the victim's hometown and finds that some secrets just do not stay buried.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: The Truth About Charlie
programme.desc: Regina (Thandie Newton) meets charming Joshua (Mark Wahlberg) while vacationing in Martinique, as she contemplates ending her whirlwind marriage to enigmatic Charlie (Stephen Dillane). Then upon her return to Paris, she finds that both her apartment and her bank account have been emptied, and her husband has been murdered. The more Reggie learns, the more she realizes the scope of the puzzle, which she must solve to protect herself from ever-increasing danger.

programme.title: Judy Moody and the NOT Bummer Summer

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album On the Road the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the first of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bill Evans, Chuck Israels & Larry Bunker
programme.sub-title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 & '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 & '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans' ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson. This recording includes Evans' renditions of the rarely performed “Sareen Jurer,” “Blue Serge”, and “Twelve Tone Tune Two.” Among the many surprises in this collection is a live performance of “My Melancholy Baby” with saxophonist Lee Konitz.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie

programme.title: Sammy Price
programme.sub-title: Sammy Price and the Harlem Beggars
programme.desc: Pianist, singer and civil rights activist Sammy Price is joined by the gospel singers known as the Harlem Beggars for spirited renditions of “Go Tell It on the Mountain,” “I'm a Soldier,” and “When the Saints Go Marching In,” among several others. The group is joined by Wilbert Harrison, who provides accompaniment on organ.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.sub-title: Jones Thad, A Child Is Born
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto
programme.sub-title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto's second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano. The band features Marcello Gilberto, David Sacks, Gil Goldstein, and Eduardo da Fonseca. Astrud started to record her own compositions in the '70s. She has recorded songs in Portuguese, English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, and Japanese.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Silas Bjerregard, Clara Cecilie Thomsen, eee gee & Caspar Phillipson
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: The King Of Comedy
programme.desc: A struggling comedian gambles his uncertain future on a crazy scheme to ransom his way onto television by kidnapping a popular talk show host.

programme.title: She's The Man
programme.desc: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: A Monster Calls
programme.desc: From the director of THE IMPOSSIBLE and the producers of PAN'S LABRYNTH, A MONSTER CALLS is a searing and fantastical story of one boy's journey to confront the truth.

programme.title: The 39 Steps
programme.desc: A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage agent, but when the agent is killed and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring that is trying to steal top-secret information.

programme.title: Camille
programme.desc: Camille is a courtesan living in Paris, and she falls head over heels for a promising young guy named Armand Duval. Armand's dad, worried about his son's future, asks Camille not to marry Armand so he can focus on his career and social status. Camille agrees and breaks up with Armand, even though it's tough for her. But later, when she's struggling with money and gets really sick, she finds out that Armand still loves her.

programme.title: My Name Is Nobody
programme.desc: A young, easy-going gunman worships and competes with a famed gunfighter, insisting that he must face down a gang of 150 outlaws before he can retire.Iconic, epic and Classic Western with Superstars Henry Fonda and Terence Hill.

programme.title: Here Kills the Bride
programme.desc: Carlos' sister finds out that he is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club. His sister investigates and gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk.

programme.title: Jumper

programme.desc: Old-school salesmen Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) try to reboot their careers by joining Google's fiercely competitive internship program — with hilarious results!

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: The torrid true-life tale of how a passionate love affair fueled the creation of trailblazing writer Mary Shelley's Gothic masterwork, Frankenstein. Elle Fanning stars.

programme.title: Rookie Blue

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: After months working undercover, Andy and Nick's operation goes sideways when Nick - then Andy - go missing.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: Three friends get caught in a standoff with a psychopath, a truck driver, a line cook, and head crime boss.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: When the White House is taken over by terrorists, a former agent must step up and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: A protection agent is tasked with protecting Darius Kincaid, one of the world's most famous assassins.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Tomorrow Morning
programme.desc: Tomorrow Morning is the story of one couple seen in two separate timelines, a decade apart. This is a story of life, love, misunderstanding and hope... a universal and timeless tale.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: To Be Someone
programme.desc: When an unhinged gangster coerces young nightclub owner, Danny, into completing an illegal drugs run to The Isle of Wight in return for his shares in the club, Danny's friends step in with an ingenious plan - they will all go to The Isle of Wight's annual Mod festival and use the thousands of Mod enthusiasts descending onto the island as a cover! A feel-good tale of modern-day mods, music, and scooter culture from the producer of The Krays and Love, Honor and Obey, starring the original cast of cult mods n' rockers film, Quadrophenia, including Leslie Ash (Men Behaving Badly), Mark Wingett (Snow White and the Huntsman), Toyah Willcox (Invasion Planet Earth), Trevor Laird (Doctor Who) and Gary Shail, alongside Sam Gittins (Await Further Instructions) and Perry Benson (This is England, Sid and Nancy).

programme.title: Lapsis
programme.desc: Struggling to support himself and his brother, Ray takes up work in the gig economy, laying cable to connect mysterious floating cubes. The job is strange but extremely lucrative. As time passes his job becomes automated and he finds himself competing with the robot cablers. With this added pressure and growing hostility from those on the trail with him, will Ray even make it through the day?

programme.title: Mythica: The Iron Crown
programme.desc: Good and evil battle it out in the fourth gripping adventure from the fantastical franchise. When daring young wizard Marek steals the final piece of the all-powerful Darkspore she embarks on a desperate quest to deliver the cursed artefact to the gods. But is caught in a death race between a ruthless team of elite mercenaries and a trinity of demons.

programme.title: Let Go
programme.desc: Featuring the king of comedy Kevin Hart, this hilarious, unconventional and heartfelt journey is all about love, loss and other felonies! Discontent parole officer Walter is struggling with the humdrums of married life, when three troublesome ex-cons are placed under his supervision. Little does Walter know that these eccentric strangers are the inspiration he was looking for!

programme.title: JT Leroy
programme.desc: A captivating retelling of one of the literary worlds most infamous hoaxes. Laura Albert (Laura Dern) writes as her avatar, a disenfranchised young queer man named JT LeRoy. When her novel becomes a best-seller, she wants to remain anonymous. Enter her boyfriends androgynous sister Savannah (Kristen Stewart), who agrees to be JT in the public eye.
