programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: The Martini Shot
programme.desc: This existential comedy follows an ailing movie director as he shoots what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal movie, ends up being an exploration of mortality and one's profound effect on the world.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Man in the Hat
programme.desc: The Man in the Hat (Ciarán Hinds) journeys through France in a Fiat 500 accompanied by a framed photograph of an unknown woman. He is pursued by five angry men in a Citroën Dyane.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: Christmas By Design
programme.desc: (2023) Festive rom com with Rebecca Dalton. Reluctantly in her hometown for Christmas, can NYC fashion designer Charlotte discover what's really important in life with the help of a charming local?

programme.title: Spotlight on Christmas
programme.desc: A Hollywood actress returns to her hometown during the holidays after a public break-up. Once there, Olivia finally takes a starring role in her own life. Starring Tori Anderson (2020)

programme.title: The Christmas Club
programme.desc: (2019) Yuletide romance starring Elizabeth Mitchell. When two busy strangers unite to help an elderly woman find her Christmas savings, they realise what their lives have been missing: true love.

programme.title: The Christmas Setup
programme.desc: (2020) Festive rom com with Hugo Spencer and Blake Lee. Back home for Christmas, big city lawyer Hugo is set up by his matchmaker mum with his high school crush Patrick. Is the magic still there?

programme.title: Christmas Crush
programme.desc: Addie makes a whimsical Christmas wish for her next-door neighbour to fall in love with her. But will she be able to break the spell when her wish goes awry? Starring Cindy Sampson (2019)

programme.title: Rules Don't Apply
programme.desc: An aspiring young actress and her ambitious young driver struggle hopefully with the absurd eccentricities of the wildly unpredictable billionaire Howard Hughes, for whom they work.

programme.title: The Rewrite
programme.desc: Once upon a time, screenwriter Keith Michaels was on top of the world. But now, he's divorced, broke and hasn't written a hit film in years. His attitude slowly begins to turn when he meets Holly, a single mum.

programme.title: Between The Lights
programme.desc: When skeptical scientist Alice falls for reluctant medium Jay, she's taken on an odyssey of love, loss and discovery that will turn her world upside down.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

programme.title: Autumn Stables
programme.desc: After her husband's death, Autumn sells her ranch to Jake expecting nothing will change, but Jake has ulterior motives with the land and her heart. Starring: Cindy Busby, Kevin McGarry, Alys Crocker

programme.title: The Loss Adjuster
programme.desc: Hapless Insurance Loss Adjuster - Martin Dyer - feels his life is spiralling out of control but discovers that even when you reach rock bottom, that some clouds really do have a silver lining.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: OLIVIA is picked to run the Christmas recital of The Nutcracker. When a video of Michael practising ballet with Lily goes viral, Olivia sees how much dance really means to the community. Will Olivia be able to save her dance studio with Michael's help?

programme.title: The Christmas Gift
programme.desc: Inspired by a true story. Ten-year-old Wesley puts together a "Secret Santa" gift for a needy child and when ten-year-old Megan opens the package, she discovers an item that will have a huge impact on her life to come.

programme.title: Cream of the Crop
programme.desc: High-school Ag Science teacher Jodi Stafford meets commercial real-estate marketing specialist Mike Jared during her struggle to save her family's ailing dairy farm.

programme.title: Eat, Drink And Be Married
programme.desc: Three days from their wedding, Jess and Max are about to call it off. However, Jess starts to question her decision when Max's brother enlists the help of Billie to save the wedding, and in the process starts to fall for her.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Charlotte's taking her chance in the big city. She just began working for the hottest romance site writing their hit weekly dating article, and her new best friend, Lila, is as fun as she is loyal. She also befriends a coffee barista, Liam, who shows her all the best spots in the city. But dating a new guy each week to write about is making her feel burned out. And when Liam develops feelings for her, Charlotte will need to decide whether her work is more important than her chance at love.

programme.title: Farm To Fork To Love
programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. After a disastrous night serving a food critic, she receives an invitation to judge a food competition in honor of the prestigious annual fundraiser for the St. Andrew's Children's Hospital. Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. Once she gets to Kansas, Alice is surprised to find her former boyfriend in college, CHRISTIAN (Scot cooper), is amongst the judges. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

programme.title: Deadly Cheers
programme.desc: Brianna and Julie move to a new town for high school and competitive cheer team.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Cheerleaders
programme.desc: Ava tries out for cheerleading, pushed by mom Candice Katrina cozies up.

programme.title: Cheerleader Nightmare
programme.desc: Sophie catches cheating boyfriend via drone suspected after cheerleader's death.

programme.title: Jewish Federation / Alberto / Tamara
programme.desc: A crazed gunman demands an end to the war in Iraq and shoots four workers.

programme.title: Deadly Cheers
programme.desc: Brianna and Julie move to a new town for high school and competitive cheer team.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: True crime writer, Kate, believes her children book writing days with her ex-boyfriend, Josh, are long over until her publisher requests a sequel. When problems begin to rise during the creative process, Kate and Josh decide to relive their past forcing them to fall in love all over again.

programme.title: Inconceivable
programme.desc: A woman interprets a kiss at a high school reunion as an invitation to follow her ex across the country and supplant his current family.

programme.title: InstaPsycho
programme.desc: When a selfie turns fatal, a woman must protect her teen daughter from a friend obsessed with social media.

programme.title: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: Laura Paddington is overcome with joy when her daughter, Zoe, returns to her after being abducted 17 years before--but is Zoe really her long lost child?

programme.title: The Winning Season
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell and fast rising star Emma Roberts, comes the hilarious story of a washed up basketball coach who must learn to overcome his love of booze.

programme.title: 36 Husbands
programme.desc: 36 Husbands is a mystical, musical, Kung Fu spy comedy starring 3 powerful women - and a bunch of husbands. Krista, top spy and Kung Fu master, has extraordinary powers and she puts them in action on her quest to slow down the steady march towards World War III.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: Isabella, a young Hollywood starlet, recalls how the actions of charming Broadway director, Arnold, changed her life forever.

programme.title: Electric Jesus
programme.desc: When a promoter sells a Christian metal band on the promise of a summer tour in 1986, their desire to "make Jesus famous" meets the complexities and confusion of personal ambition, youthful zeal, lifelong friendships, and first love.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: There are only a few days left before the Mother's Day, as several families have to come to terms with how they'll be spending the big day.

programme.title: Flaming Frontier
programme.desc: Old Surehand and his loyal companion Old Wabble pursue a ruthless killer known as “The General,” who murdered Surehand's brother. Their quest draws them into escalating tensions between settlers and the Comanches. With the help of his blood brother Winnetou, they must seek justice while trying to prevent all-out war.

programme.title: Belle Starr's Daughter
programme.desc: The daughter of famous outlaw Belle Starr arrives at the town where her mother was murdered to find her killer.

programme.title: The Godless Ones
programme.desc: An outlaw and a bounty hunter are searching for Mexican bandit Corbancho, who is running the El Paso area, and has also robbed the Bank of Tuscon of $400,000.

programme.title: The Relentless Four
programme.desc: Texas Ranger Sam Garrett sets out to clear Rex Calhoun's name but is betrayed by four ruthless cowboys. Left for dead and later framed for murder, Garrett escapes jail only to find a bounty on his own head. Now hunted by killers and the law, he must fight to survive and uncover the truth.

programme.title: Heart of the Matter
programme.desc: Harry Scobie, Deputy Commissioner of Police, commits his first offence which leads to his ultimate downfall.

programme.title: That Hamilton Woman
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh star as Lord Nelson and Lady Hamilton.

programme.title: On the Night of the Fire
programme.desc: Kobling is a barber who steals £100 to pay off his wife's debt.

programme.title: Passionate Summer
programme.desc: An idealistic young schoolmaster arrives at a Jamaican boarding school.

programme.title: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia discovers that she was Cleopatra's servant in a past life when she experiences déjà vu while watching a catalog from an Ancient Egyptian relics exposition.

programme.title: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney and her student Adam are onto his ancestors' fabled Eyes of Toklamanee, but they are pursued by mysterious gunmen.

programme.title: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are ambushed in Russia. Two weeks later, Sydney wakes up in the house of a man called Tsarlov, who claims to have saved her.

programme.title: M.I.A.
programme.desc: Sydney gets kidnapped, but by whom? Nigel, Claudia and Cate will have to go through the list of enemies Sydney has made in the past and deduce which of them is responsible. Cue flashbacks.

programme.title: Dont Go Into the Woods
programme.desc: Sydney's friend phones to inform her that he's discovered information on the Golden Hawk of Maribor, lost since 1711. Sydney and Nigel travel to Lubjanka to meet him, but he's already gone.

programme.title: French Connection
programme.desc: While on a lecture tour with Nigel in Europe, Sydney is contacted by MI5 because she is the only one who can prevent an impending high-level assassination.

programme.title: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: The Executioners Mask
programme.desc: When a model's face is disfigured after she puts on the mask of a French executioner, Sydney and Nigel will try and find the tomb to reverse the curse.

programme.title: Enemy Within
programme.desc: When a Japanese fighter pilot crash-lands on the tiny remote Hawaiian island of Ni'ihau, he is met with courtesy and traditional Hawaiian hospitality from the locals.

programme.title: Saints and Soldiers
programme.desc: Germany, May 1945, deep in the Harz Mountains a U.S. tank crew discovers a platoon of Germans preparing to ambush U.S. supply trucks. A deadly game of cat and mouse quickly unfolds as the Americans find themselves out-gunned and out-manned by three German tanks.

programme.title: Warriors' Gate
programme.desc: American teenager Jack Bronson is magically transported to ancient China, where he must become a hero and rescue a beautiful princess from the clutches of the evil barbarian king.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: At 500 MPH disaster is inevitable. When an experiment goes disastrously wrong, a rash of massive hurricanes rips across North America. A scientist must get his family to safety before the hurricanes merge, creating a "hypercane" with the power to wipe America off the map.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Deeply ensconced in a top-secret military program, three pilots struggle to bring an artificial intelligence program under control ... before it initiates the next world war.

programme.title: Residen Evil: Retribution
programme.desc: Alice fights alongside a resistance movement to regain her freedom from an Umbrella Corporation testing facility. A sequel to Resident Evil: Afterlife 3D.

programme.title: The Net
programme.desc: With a story ripped from today's headlines, THE NET is a compelling, high-tech drama about a computer systems analyst (Sandra Bullock) who becomes caught in a web of intrigue and conspiracy when she accidentally taps into a classified program.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: A Most Deadly Family
programme.desc: Mary Tyler Moore stars as Sante Kimes in the extraordinary true story of a woman whose childhood of abuse and exploitation left a legacy of amorality that she passes on to her son.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: A Dark Place
programme.desc: When a young boy goes missing in a sleepy backwoods town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation.

programme.title: Cover-Up [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: The violent impulses of Bob Malone (Michael Rooker), a former Los Angeles policeman forced to leave his job in disgrace, get the better of him during a bank robbery, and he wipes out nearly all the robbers. Meanwhile, Koji (Ryo Ishibashi), a Yakuza killer in town to meet with the local Mafia, turns the tables on a deranged terrorist who threatens to bomb an eatery. Corrupt cops bring Koji in, but he soon escapes from custody -- taking Malone and his daughter, Chelsea (Danielle Harris), hostage.

programme.title: Un amour d'animateur
programme.desc: Savannah est engagée pour redorer le blason d'un animateur de radio à New York. Elle se retrouve accidentellement à l'antenne avec celui-ci.

programme.title: Amour au glaçage royal
programme.desc: Emma, pâtissière à New York, est engagée pour la fête d'anniversaire du roi et de la reine de Sanovia.

programme.title: Amour, set et match
programme.desc: Liz, une enseignante au secondaire, met ses élèves au défi de créer des plans d'affaires : ils lancent une application de rencontre.

programme.title: Coup de foudre sucré salé
programme.desc: Une critique de restaurant doit se faire passer pour la cuisinière du chef qu'elle a insulté pour faire amende honorable.

programme.title: The Notorious Landlady
programme.desc: An American junior diplomat in London rents a house from, and falls in love with, a woman suspected of murder.

programme.title: A Woman Of Distinction
programme.desc: A publicist's efforts to create buzz about an astronomer's visit creates problems for a dean of a college.

programme.title: The Silencers
programme.desc: An organization wants to sabatoge the American atomic missile system.

programme.title: Judy Moody and the NOT Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: The Last Unicorn
programme.desc: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: Personal disputes and problems with drugs, alcohol and illness accompany the musical quintet's rise to fame.

programme.title: The Temptations

programme.desc: Discover this life affirming journey on the world's most renowned long distance trek...The Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: Lunch Hour
programme.desc: Students, principals and health experts expose the troubling reality of school cafeteria food.

programme.title: The Decathletes
programme.desc: Granada Hills Charter High School in Los Angeles sets out to cement their legacy in the academic decathlon.

programme.title: Sex and Broadcasting

programme.title: Masterson Of Kansas

programme.title: Adventures In Silverado

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas helps his former Army captain, now an undercover federal agent, infiltrate a gang of bank robbers.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album On the Road the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the first of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Bill Evans, Chuck Israels & Larry Bunker
programme.sub-title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 & '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 & '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans' ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson. This recording includes Evans' renditions of the rarely performed “Sareen Jurer,” “Blue Serge”, and “Twelve Tone Tune Two.” Among the many surprises in this collection is a live performance of “My Melancholy Baby” with saxophonist Lee Konitz.

programme.title: Sammy Price
programme.sub-title: Sammy Price and the Harlem Beggars
programme.desc: Pianist, singer and civil rights activist Sammy Price is joined by the gospel singers known as the Harlem Beggars for spirited renditions of “Go Tell It on the Mountain,” “I'm a Soldier,” and “When the Saints Go Marching In,” among several others. The group is joined by Wilbert Harrison, who provides accompaniment on organ.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.sub-title: Jones Thad, A Child Is Born
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto
programme.sub-title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto's second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano. The band features Marcello Gilberto, David Sacks, Gil Goldstein, and Eduardo da Fonseca. Astrud started to record her own compositions in the '70s. She has recorded songs in Portuguese, English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, and Japanese.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Silas Bjerregard, Clara Cecilie Thomsen, eee gee & Caspar Phillipson
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Robert Plant
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Michael Bolton
programme.sub-title: Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without You?", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. Simply a wonderful night.

programme.desc: Lenny Kravitz has been consolidated as one of the stars that has been in force for a long time, this has led him to appear all over the world and be part of the most popular festivals in the world. programme.title: Phillip Morris ¡Te quiero!
programme.desc: La improbable pero cierta historia de Steven Russell, un vendedor de una pequeña localidad de Estados Unidos que acaba en la cárcel. Allí conoce a un presidiario, Phillip Morris, del que se enamorará perdidamente.

programme.title: American Playboy

Todas sus fantasías se hacen realidad cuando las chicas más guapas y más deseadas del país no quieren separarse de él.

programme.title: Las marismas

La foto de la tumba de una niña fallecida misteriosamente en 1974 hallada en el domicilio de la víctima conduce a Erlendur y a su compañero Sigurdur Óli a un pasado turbio, un laberinto de corrupción con implicaciones inesperadas y aterradoras...

programme.title: Recursos humanos

Lleno de ilusión e ingenuidad, está convencido de que sus esfuerzos servirán para que los sindicatos y la dirección alcancen un acuerdo sobre la jornada laboral. Sin embargo, pronto se da cuenta de que su trabajo está, en realidad, al servicio de una reorganización de la empresa, que implica una reducción de la plantilla.

La evolución que sufre su relación coge a ambos por sorpresa, al encontrarse bajo la influencia de la droga final: el amor.

programme.title: Buster: El robo del siglo

programme.title: Memorias de un hombre invisible
programme.desc: Un experimento del Gobierno fracasa y vuelve invisible a un testigo casual.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Desesperado por una buena historia, un periodista adicto al sexo se sumerge en el mundo de las señoritas de compañía de lujo cuando comienza a seguirle los pasos a una prostituta licenciada en Stanford.

programme.title: Hincame el Diente
programme.desc: ´Vampires Suck´ es una comedia sobre la ansiedad adolescente. Becca es una adolescente no vampiro que se debate entre dos chicos. Antes de que pueda elegir, Becca debe sortear a su padre.

programme.title: Rumores Y Mentiras
programme.desc: El guión, obra del dramaturgo Bert V. Royal, es una versión moderna y en clave estudiantil de “La letra escarlata”, la novela de Nathaniel Hawthorne. Narra la historia de una joven que decide fingir que lleva una vida promiscua, creyendo que así obtendrá algún tipo de beneficio. Sin embargo, las circunstancias se volverán en su contra.

programme.title: Paternidad
programme.desc: Kevin Hart protagoniza esta conmovedora historia real sobre un padre viudo que se enfrenta a dudas, miedos, angustias y pañales sucios mientras se dispone a criar a su hija por su cuenta.

programme.title: No Me Mientas Que Te Creo
programme.desc: Los populares cómicos Richard Pryor y Gene Wilder son un par de mentirosos patológicos hechos el uno para el otro.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: Rogers y Clarke (Warren Beatty y Dustin Hoffman) son dos ineptos compositores sin suerte y desesperados por dinero. El dúo acepta el consejo de su sospechoso agente, y en un abrir y cerrar de ojos está en un recorrido por la mística república de Ishtar. A su llegada, nuestros héroes son reclutados por separado como espías de los bandos contrarios de una revolución planeada, y al mismo tiempo se disputan la atención de una hermosa revolucionaria (Isabelle Adjani). Sin embargo, Clarke y Rogers son peores espías que compositores, y en poco tiempo terminan varados en el desierto en compañía de un camello ciego y de varios asesinos de la CIA.

programme.title: La senda de la traición
programme.desc: Tras la Guerra Civil, el forajido Rollins y su banda provocan tensiones entre colonos e indígenas. Winnetou y Old Shatterhand intentan mantener la paz, pero Winnetou es acusado de asesinar al hijo del jefe Búfalo Blanco, con pruebas falsas. Old Shatterhand debe descubrir la verdad y salvar a su amigo.

programme.title: Frontera de tormentas
programme.desc: Tras escapar de la banda de los Silers, Winnetou y su hermana llegan a Miramonte junto a Old Firehand. Mientras la banda prepara un ataque para liberar a uno de los suyos, Old Firehand descubre un importante secreto familiar. Unidos, deberán organizar la defensa del pueblo frente a la inminente amenaza.

programme.title: La frontera en llamas
programme.desc: Old Surehand y su fiel amigo Old Wabble persiguen a un asesino frío conocido como «El General», responsable de la muerte del hermano de Surehand. En su camino se ven atrapados en el conflicto entre colonos y comanches, al borde de la guerra. Con el apoyo de Winnetou, intentan hacer justicia y evitar un derramamiento de sangre.

programme.title: Los Largos Dias de la Venganza
programme.desc: Después de tres años de trabajos forzados, Ted Barnett se escapa de la cárcel para vengarse de los tres hombres que lo incriminaron.

programme.title: Encontrando el amor en San Antonio
programme.desc: Adela Romero, chef de televisión, debe decidir entre aceptar un programa que la llevará por Europa o quedarse en San Antonio tras la fuga de su hija. Allí conoce a un crítico gastronómico local que cambia su perspectiva y le ayuda a redescubrir la ciudad y lo que realmente importa.

programme.title: Haz caso a tu corazón
programme.desc: Un cantautor se enamora de una chica que no puede escuchar la música que ella le inspira.

programme.title: Yo soy otro
programme.desc: José, un ingeniero de sistemas, descubre en su piel los signos de la "litomiasis", una misteriosa enfermedad aún no clasificada en la que el cuerpo está totalmente cubierto por una segunda piel de bacterias voraces.

programme.title: Druid Peak
programme.desc: Un adolescente problemático es enviado a vivir con su padre, un guardaparques con quien apenas tiene relación. En el aislamiento del parque nacional, desarrolla un vínculo profundo e inesperado con una manada de lobos que transformará su vida.

programme.title: La conspiración del silencio
programme.desc: El joven fiscal Johann Radmann encuentra unos documentos que le permiten poner en marcha un proceso judicial contra algunos miembros de las SS que sirvieron en Auschwitz. Pero los horrores del pasado y la hostilidad hacia su trabajo lo llevan cerca del colapso, pues le resulta casi imposible abrirse paso a través de un laberinto en el que todo el mundo parece estar implicado o ser culpable.

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira
programme.desc: Théo es un niño que vive empeñado en levantarle el ánimo a su padre, Laurent, un tipo solitario y completamente desilusionado con la vida. La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: Collider
programme.desc: En el año 2033, una joven atrapada en un misterioso orfanato viaja imprudentemente al pasado para encontrar a sus padres y enmendar su pasado.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: Cuando el mejor amigo del ex sheriff Alden Rockwell es tiroteado, éste se ofrece como investigador privado para averiguar la verdad tras el tiroteo y descubre una conspiración criminal entre dos condados.

programme.title: Cut off (esp)
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: Breach
programme.desc: A punto de convertirse en padre, un joven mecánico a bordo de un arca interestelar rumbo a la Nueva Tierra debe ingeniárselas para vencer a un terror cósmico maligno que pretende usar la nave espacial como arma.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: Jackie Chan: Maestro en Kung Fu
programme.desc: Jackie Chan es el invicto Maestro de Kung Fu que reparte acción al estilo tradicional de Jackie Chan. Cuando un joven se dispone a aprender a luchar del mismísimo Maestro, no sólo es testigo de espectaculares combates, sino que aprende importantes lecciones de vida por el camino.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Un cártel de droga colombiano se alía con un grupo de Triads de Hong Kong y con el sicario más atactivo del planeta para enviar dos toneladas de cocaína a Australia y a China.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Un mensajero de Nueva York (Taylor Lautner) se ve envuelto en una trama criminal. 'Tracers' está ambientada en el espectacular mundo del parkour, una técnica de desplazamiento en la que hay que superar todos los obstáculos usando las habilidades del cuerpo humano: saltando vallas, muros, etc.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Un grupo de ladrones internacionales liderado por Macao-Park se dispone a poner en marcha un plan maestro para dar el golpe del siglo en un casino. Pero como el honor no existe entre ladrones, cada uno de ellos organiza por separado su propio y personal plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: El almirante: Mar de fuego
programme.desc: En 1597, Yi Sun-Shin lidera 12 barcos contra más de 300 navíos japoneses en una batalla histórica.

programme.title: Ultimate Justice
programme.desc: Cuando un familiar es atacado, un equipo de antiguos soldados de élite es llamado de nuevo a la acción.

programme.title: One Million K(l)icks
programme.desc: Un luchador con un corazón de oro se ve arrastrado a un torneo de artes marciales clandestino.

programme.title: Gun Fight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un sheriff en un enfrentamiento con una sanguinaria banda de forajidos.

programme.title: Invasión A La Tierra
programme.desc: Durante muchos años ha habido casos documentados sobre testigos que han visto OVNIS en todo el mundo.Pero lo que hasta ese momento eran simples avistamientos, en 2011 se convierte en una terrible realidad cuando la Tierra es atacada por fuerzas desconocidas.Una tras otra van cayendo las grandes ciudades del mundo, y Los Ángeles se ha convertido en el último bastión de la humanidad. Un sargento de la Marina (Aaron Eckhart) y sus hombres tendrán que enfrentarse en una inesperada batalla a un enemigo absolutamente desconocido.

programme.title: The Mask Of Zorro
programme.desc: Cuando un déspota sediento de poder planea comprarle California a México, hacen falta dos Zorros - el legendario Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) y su sucesor elegido Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas), un gallardo bandido convertido en héroe - para frustrar los planes sin escrúpulos del tirano. ¿Pero bastará la combinación de sus habilidades, sus bravuconerías y proezas para lograr el objetivo final de De la Vega: vengarse del hombre que mató a su mujer, secuestró a su hija y lo tuvo prisionero durante veinte años?

programme.title: La Leyenda Del Zorro
programme.desc: ¡El justiciero de la capa original ha regresado! Antonio Banderas y la ganadora del Oscar(r) Catherine Zeta-Jones (2002, mejor actriz de reparto, Chicago) vuelven con más duelos a espada, aventuras y emoción en el explosivo espectáculo cinematográfico, ¡THE LEGEND OF ZORRO! Tras pasar los últimos diez años luchando contra la injusticia y la crueldad, Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) se enfrenta ahora a su mayor desafío: ¡su amada esposa Elena (Zeta-Jones) lo ha echado de casa! Elena ha pedido el divorcio y ha encontrado cobijo en los brazos del conde Armand (Rufus Sewell), un apuesto aristócrata francés. Pero Alejandro sabe algo que ella no sabe: Armand es el maligno cerebro de una trama terrorista para destruir Estados Unidos. Así, con su matrimonio y el futuro del país en juego, el Zorro debe salvar dos uniones antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Un escuadrón de pilotos de élite se embarca en una peligrosa misión. Intentan neutralizar un prototipo de avión de combate que está fuera de control y que dispone de un sistema de inteligencia artificial cuyas acciones podrían desencadenar una guerra nuclear.
